decisions.reason: As an incremental extension that stayed on the website through 2024 and fits the firm's established spraying portfolio, it likely has low carrying cost and still retains option value.
Its own product page in both years signals committed commercialization, and as a close-to-core injection pump the firm is likely to keep learning from the market rather than exit quickly.
Because it builds on proven air-motor technology and complements the existing pump range, it is inexpensive to carry and there is little evidence that its value has been disproven.
The product remained prominently marketed and also supports the firm's move toward more digitalized, interoperable customer solutions, so management is likely to preserve this option.

Since it was only launched in 2024 and is close to the core offer, uncertainty is still unresolved and the firm is likely to keep the product on the market for another year unless uptake is clearly weak.
